title: ias15: a fast, adaptive, high-order integrator for gravitational dynamics, accurate to machine precision over a billion orbits
relevance: 15th-order adaptive integrator achieving machine-precision energy conservation, the gold standard for adaptive gravitational integration.

title: An adaptive symplectic integrator, SQQ-PTQ, for gravitational dynamics
relevance: Adaptive symplectic integrator using time transformation and Chebyshev interpolation, maintaining symplecticity with variable steps.

title: THE GENGA CODE: GRAVITATIONAL ENCOUNTERS IN N-BODY SIMULATIONS WITH GPU ACCELERATION
relevance: GPU-accelerated hybrid symplectic integrator with adaptive close-encounter handling, extending the hybrid integration scheme to higher orders.

title: An efficient integrator for stellar dynamics in effective gravity fields based on the isochrone potential
relevance: Novel splitting scheme using isochrone potential drifts, showing orders of magnitude better efficiency in certain dynamical regimes.
